It discusses the need for \"orthogonal validation across different model systems\" and hedging claims based on \"evolutionary closeness and naturalistic tendencies, which generally inform the extent of translatability to humans.\"",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "animal models have inherent limitations to translatability, such as their inability to recapitulate human-specific transcriptional paradigms and the protracted development of the human brain",
    "A perfect animal model of ASD is untenable because autism, especially facets of it that arise at the interface of developmental gene expression programs and neuronal circuits, is human specific",
    "rodent models have limited similarity with humans, especially in terms of neuroanatomy and physiology",
    "rodents have a small prefrontal cortex (PFC) and lack the dorsolateral PFC altogether",
    "neocortex constitutes a much smaller proportion of the rodent brain compared to primates",
    "divergence in gene expression pattern and regulation as well as lack of certain neuronal cell types in the rodent brain",
    "prohibitive maintenance costs and ethical considerations limit the use of NHPs",
    "small sample size of NHPs precludes studying the heterogeneity in ASD presentation",
    "human stem cell-based models still fall short of being an ideal ASD model, primarily because the molecular changes observed here cannot be correlated to behavior",
    "emergent network-level phenotypes observed in assembloids are still very basic compared to the complex behavioral repertoire of an animal model",
    "dosage and timing of signaling cues that are ectopically administered and acute in nature, as opposed to sustained, controlled endemic cues that developing brain cells are exposed to",
    "gaps in our knowledge about how neurons migrate and connect with other neurons to form circuits",
    "circuit-level properties of neurons significantly differ from their individual cellular properties, and these contribute to behavior",
    "ASD diagnosis is based on a set of observed and reported behaviors, which are difficult to model even in NHPs, as correlates of mental states cannot be reliably ascertained across species",
    "the cytoarchitecture of the human brain, in important areas such as the PFC and Brodmann area, differs even from other hominoid species",
    "postmortem human brain tissue is confounded by changes that accumulate due to living with ASD and may not be representative of developmental disruptions",
    "the more advanced the model, the greater is the cost associated with its maintenance",
    "NHP models and clinical samples are inherently limited in number and have stringent regulations for their ethical use",
    "limited overlap in FMRP brain interactome across species",
    "the co-expression pattern of nitric oxide synthase 1 and FMRP varies between mice and human mid-fetal layer V pyramidal neurons, suggesting that this aspect of ASD cannot be modeled in Fmr1 KO mice",
    "the effect of genetic variants can differ among backgrounds, as shown for different strains of mice exhibiting varying levels of resilience to loss of one Chd8 allele",
    "Rat models of RTT exhibit impaired juvenile play and regression of acquired psychomotor skills, traits that cannot be modeled in mice",
    "Multiple mouse models (germline line or brain-specific postnatal KO) do not recapitulate the brain development aspect of RTT, as there is a delay in the onset of symptoms",
    "animal models may not display species-specific differences in drug sensitivity"
  ],
  "funding_conflict": "The authors declare no conflicts of interest.",

    "ASD affecting around 1–3% of individuals globally",
    "males outnumber females at a ratio of 4:1 for ASD",
    "more than 1100 ASD risk genes at varying levels of confidence",
    "Inherited recessive variants explain only a fraction (2–19%) of ASD risk",
    "cumulatively common SNPs explain 17–52% of ASD risk",
    "Approximately 85% of ASD cases are idiopathic (without any known genetic etiology), a large fraction of which can be attributed to DNVs",
    "The expected rate of DNV is estimated to be ~2 × 10 8 /base/generation",
    "CNVs with coding DNVs explain 30% of simplex families (25% boys and 45% girls)",
    "VPA is required in a much lower dose to induce ASD-related phenotypes in pigs (50 to 75 mg/kg) compared to monkeys",
    "RNA sequencing done on fibroblasts (from 71 individuals of the Undiagnosed Diseases Network) differentiated into iNs increased the diagnostic yield to 25.4%",
    "iNs can now be maintained for as long as 150 days in vitro",
    "3-month-old cortical GNOs models 19–24 gestational weeks to 6 months postnatal brain",
    "Humans diverged from mice, macaques and chimpanzees ~80, 25, and 6 million years ago, respectively",
    "C. elegans has a short 3-day life cycle",
    "C. elegans has 302 neurons",
